ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Kaushalya Logistics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Kaushalya Logistics Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

Press Release — Kaushalya Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated February 26, 2026, titled "Kaushalya Logistics Launches Multimodal Operations with First Rake; Pan-India Expansion of New Vertical".

Press Release — Kaushalya Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated December 08, 2025, titled "Kaushalya Logistics Expands Partnership with Shree Cement, Opens 17th New Depot in Haryana".
